# Global Grabz

> Global Grabz is a China sourcing agent for international buyers. We find and verify factories, negotiate prices, inspect quality and ship goods from China to the USA, Europe, Australia, Asia and the Middle East.

Website: https://www.globalgrabz.com/
Email: contact@globalgrabz.com
Phone and WhatsApp (Pakistan): +92 304 0370389
Phone (China): +86 130 1899 1840
Phone (Dubai, UAE): +971 56 700 2406
Quote response target: within 1 hour

## Services

- [Product Sourcing from China](https://www.globalgrabz.com/services/product-sourcing): shortlist factories, compare quotes and negotiate price and MOQ.
- [Supplier Verification and Factory Audit](https://www.globalgrabz.com/services/supplier-verification): licence checks, factory or trading company confirmation and site visits.
- [Quality Inspection and AQL Checks](https://www.globalgrabz.com/services/quality-inspection): pre-production, in-production and pre-shipment inspection.
- [Sample Management and Try Before You Buy](https://www.globalgrabz.com/services/sample-management): collect, check and ship samples before bulk orders.
- [Private Label and OEM Manufacturing](https://www.globalgrabz.com/services/private-label-oem): custom logos, packaging and OEM production.
- [International Shipping and Logistics](https://www.globalgrabz.com/services/shipping-logistics): air, sea and overland freight with shipment tracking.
- [Warehousing and Cargo Consolidation](https://www.globalgrabz.com/services/warehousing-consolidation): combine goods from many suppliers into one shipment.
- [Amazon FBA Prep and Dropshipping Fulfilment](https://www.globalgrabz.com/services/fba-dropshipping): labeling, prep and direct shipping for online sellers.

## Markets we serve

- [USA](https://www.globalgrabz.com/markets/usa): sourcing and freight from China to US ports, airports and Amazon FBA warehouses.
- [Europe](https://www.globalgrabz.com/markets/europe): shipping to EU and UK ports and airports with CE and labeling checks.
- [Australia](https://www.globalgrabz.com/markets/australia): sea and air freight to Australian ports with biosecurity packaging checks.
- [Asia](https://www.globalgrabz.com/markets/asia): routes from China to South Asia, Southeast Asia and Central Asia, including China to Pakistan.
- [Middle East](https://www.globalgrabz.com/markets/middle-east): sourcing and freight to the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and the Gulf.

## China sourcing hubs

- [Yiwu](https://www.globalgrabz.com/sourcing/yiwu): small commodities, gifts and daily goods.
- [Shenzhen](https://www.globalgrabz.com/sourcing/shenzhen): electronics, gadgets and hardware.
- [Guangzhou](https://www.globalgrabz.com/sourcing/guangzhou): apparel, bags, shoes, beauty and furniture.
- [Shanghai](https://www.globalgrabz.com/sourcing/shanghai): higher value manufacturing and major container port access.
